_: The kinds of people: what a people is made of (its substrate) and how it is shaped (its modifiers), and the powers an eldritch people draws in place of a tree. The numbers of each kind are the registry in the species package; this file holds its words.

substrates and modifiers: key (the registry's), portrait (the sentence a portrait opens with), arising (how the legends say the people came to be; absent for 'arise on'), flavour (what the people calls a colony, a ship and a station; a modifier's override the substrate's).

powers: one row per power, in the pool's order: key, name, domain (the tech domain it counts as a level in), weight in the draw, node (the miracle it stands for) or filter (the filter it brings without one), line (the chronicle's line for the deepening; {S} the people), sense (the portrait's phrase).
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

substrates.portrait: They are machines, and do not remember who built them.
They are made of nothing that has a name: not flesh, not machine, and no one who has looked can say what.
They are a parasite, and need the bodies of others to think and to build.

modifiers.portrait: They are one mind, spread through the living substance of their world.
There is no one inside; they only act as if.
They make more of themselves out of whatever they find.
Nothing that has met them remembers it.
They shape their own flesh, and breed what they need instead of building it.

powers.name: the long thought
powers.line: {S} have begun to think about something, and the thinking will take an age.

powers.name: a second presence
powers.line: There is another of {S} now, at a star nothing was seen to cross to.

powers.name: the wide reach
powers.line: {S} can feel further than they could.

powers.name: the door in it
powers.line: There is a door in {S} now, and things pass through it without a ship.

powers.name: the sight
powers.line: {S} have begun to see every star within their reach as if it were under them.

powers.name: the voice
powers.line: {S} have begun to speak, and the speaking crosses any distance at once.

powers.name: the unmaking
powers.line: {S} have learned to end a world without touching it.

powers.name: the shell
powers.line: {S} have grown a shell, and nothing that comes for them gets in.

powers.name: the tithe
powers.line: {S} have begun to take a share of every harvest within their reach. Nobody agreed to it.

powers.name: the long sleep
powers.line: {S} have learned to sleep, and will sleep when there is nothing left they want.

powers.name: the mirror
powers.line: {S} have begun to answer every message in the sender's own voice.

powers.name: the wound
powers.line: There is a wound in {S}, and what is underneath everything is open there.
